Page 176 Cont.
Mrs. Susan Glenn - 67 - baptist (raised) never baptized - Arthritis .. ....
Hugo J. Stahl - 56 - brain hemorage,
Frank Jos. Herman - 73 - Toledo - Hes & Shingles
June Dallman - 19 - infatuated with Joe
Thanks - Archie MacDonald - 14 - had cancer on his back - was barred on that account from going to camp last summer. Was enrolled in Ser. Mass A. is completely cured. No sign of it left.
Page 177
Glenn Braun - 19 - Cheilitis of lips .... peculiar
Mrs. Alice Plunkett - 75 - Threatened with pneumonia .... Active III
Bruno and Ellen Gargulinski married 6 yrs ago - out of the Church - have two dear children but not practicing any religion.
Dec. 28 Page 178 1940 IN NOMINE JESU -- 1940, January
Margaret - 17 - Spinal trouble, curviture.
Jan. 2 Walter Kubtski - 20 - away from home - no heart for parents. Came back for clothes two months back. .. not seen since.
2 Richard Volway - 15 - operation last July for what threatens now as coming back a fast growing cancer. The neck seems swolen and Drs. say "only a matter of weeks". Enrolled To-night perpetual member promising - boy is 2nd oldest of 7
3 Albert Sand - 60 - Jewish suspected lung cancer. Was enrolled To- night.
3 Shirley Fitzgerald - 34 - has like infection of bone in elboe - his family needs him.
Jennie Potts - 69 - pneumonia - resigned to go if God so will .. . John Konkel - 23 - has excellent job but drinks and has bad temper. - not satisfied - little appreciation.
